title: Unsafe SQL Query Audit
hints: Never interpolate or concatenate user input directly into SQL strings—even with `addslashes()` or `str_replace()`.
Use a static SQL template with a named placeholder (`:email`) and pass `$email` inside the separate `'bindings'` array.

decisionOptions.label: Strip single quotes using str_replace() before concatenating into SQL.
Use parameterized SQL placeholders with separate parameter bindings.
Base64-encode the user email and interpolate it into the WHERE clause.
